agencies: Short agency code: BFP, PNP, CDRRMO, or CHO.
Contact email address of the agency.
File path of the agency logo shown on the dashboard.
Number of days before expiry at which a driver license is flagged as expiring soon. Configurable per agency.
Date and time the record was created.
Date and time the record was last updated.
users: Unique identifier for each user account.
Role of the user: admin or driver.
Full name of the Agency Administrator or Authorized Driver.
Email address used to sign in. Unique across the system.
Account state: pending, active, or rejected.
Driver license number. Empty for Agency Administrators.
Expiry date of the driver license. Empty for Agency Administrators.
Device token used to deliver push notifications to the mobile application.
Date and time the email address was verified.
Token used to keep a web session signed in.
Date and time the record was created.
Date and time the record was last updated.
vehicles: Primary Authorized Driver assigned to the vehicle.
Type of vehicle, such as Fire Truck, Ambulance, or Patrol Car.
Plate number of the vehicle. Unique within the agency.
Engine number of the vehicle. Unique within the agency.
Chassis number of the vehicle. Unique within the agency.
Current odometer reading in kilometers. Used for mileage-based preventive maintenance.
Single shared operational status: Operational, Dispatched, Not Operational, or Under Preventive Maintenance.
Date and time the record was created.
Date and time the record was last updated.
inspection_checklist_items: Unique identifier for each checklist item.
Name of the checklist item, such as Battery, Brakes, or Fire Pump.
Marks the two items that apply only to BFP vehicles: Hydraulic System and Fire Pump.
Order in which the item appears on the checklist.
Date and time the record was created.
Date and time the record was last updated.
inspections: Agency that owns the inspection record.
Authorized Driver who performed the inspection.
Date the daily inspection was performed.
Review state of the inspection: Pending or Reviewed.
Agency Administrator who reviewed the inspection.
Date and time the inspection was reviewed.
Date and time the inspection was submitted.
Date and time the record was last updated.
inspection_items: Unique identifier for each inspection item result.
Result for the item: OK or Has Issue.
Explanation of the fault. Required when the status is Has Issue.
damage_reports: Unique identifier for each damage report.
Agency that owns the damage report.
Authorized Driver who submitted the report.
File path of the optional photo attachment.
Date the report was submitted. Set automatically.
Review state of the report: Pending or Reviewed.
Agency Administrator who assessed the report.
Date and time the report was assessed.
Date and time the record was created.
Date and time the record was last updated.
repair_logs: Unique identifier for each repair record.
Agency that owns the repair record.
Authorized Driver assigned to the vehicle at the time of repair.
Date the repair was performed or logged.
Who performed the repair: Internal Office, GSO Motorpool, or External Repair Shop.
Name of the shop when the repair source is External Repair Shop.

Path to the supporting document for the repair — the receipt or sales invoice from an external repair shop, or the job order issued by the GSO Motorpool. Required when the repair source is External Repair Shop.
Date and time the record was created.
Date and time the record was last updated.
pm_schedules: Unique identifier for each preventive maintenance schedule.
Part or service to be maintained, such as Oil Change and Filter.
Basis of the schedule: Mileage-Based or Time-Based.
Distance in kilometers between services. Mileage-based schedules only.
Odometer reading at the last service. Mileage-based schedules only.
Odometer reading at which the service becomes due.
Date on which the service becomes due. Time-based schedules only.
Kilometers before the due mileage at which the schedule is flagged Due Soon. Configurable.
Days before the due date at which the schedule is flagged Due Soon. Configurable.
State of the schedule: Upcoming, Due Soon, Due, or Completed.
Date the service was carried out.
Who carried out the service: Internal Office, GSO Motorpool, or External Repair Shop.
Name of the shop when the completion source is External Repair Shop.

Path to the supporting document for the completed service — the receipt or sales invoice from an external repair shop, or the job order issued by the GSO Motorpool. Required when the completion repair source is External Repair Shop.
Notes and findings recorded on completion.
Date and time the record was created.
Date and time the record was last updated.
dispatches: Unique identifier for each dispatch record.
Agency that owns the dispatch record.
Type of mission: Fire Response, Medical Response, Rescue Operation, Patrol, Administrative Travel, or Others.
Description of the mission when the mission type is Others.
Location the vehicle was dispatched to.
Date and time the vehicle left. Sets the vehicle status to Dispatched.
Odometer reading recorded at time out.
Date and time the vehicle returned. Empty while the dispatch is active.
Odometer reading recorded at time in. Updates the vehicle current mileage when higher.
Status set on return: Operational, Not Operational, or Under Preventive Maintenance.
Notes recorded when the dispatch was closed.
Date and time the record was created.
Date and time the record was last updated.
notifications: Category of the alert, such as New Damage Report, Inspection Flagged, License Expiring, PM Due, or Password Reset.
Reference details such as the plate number or the record concerned.
Marks whether the recipient has opened the notification.
Date and time the notification was opened.
Date and time the record was created.
Date and time the record was last updated.
